provenance.rule: The request gives one colour per chain but not which chain gets which. Accepted: every one-to-one assignment of the named colours to the polymer chains (n! states), on a cartoon of the whole polymer.
accepted_states: chain A orange, chain B magenta
chain A magenta, chain B orange
not_accepted: a colour used on two chains, or a chain left uncoloured: the request names one colour per chain
other colours, or a colour-by-chain theme with the viewer's own colours: the request names the colours
ligands, ions or water drawn or coloured: not requested
provenance.derived: polymer chains from `facts.chains`; exactly 2 or 3; n colours by seed; all n! assignments. Reference = the first accepted state (chain A orange, chain B magenta): a bare load, which already draws the polymer as a cartoon and ligands as ball-and-stick, plus one colour call.
provenance.accepted_differ: accept-set tier: every alternative is another final state, one of the readings of the request that provenance.rule accepts

the protein chain with author id B

notes: Left open: which chain gets which colour. Reference = accepted state 1 of 2 (chain A orange, chain B magenta); the others are in 'accepted', in the order of provenance.accepted_states.
